mainEntity.name: Does Insurance Support charge fees for consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Insurance Support offers free initial consultations with no obligation. We are an independent advisory - we do not charge advisory fees. Our revenue comes from standard insurer commissions when you purchase a policy through us, at no extra cost to you compared to buying directly.
